title: Register with OregonSaves or certify a retirement plan exemption
description: Oregon employers without a qualified plan must register and facilitate payroll deductions, or certify an exemption (renewed every three years). Registration phases by size have ended. The commissioner can fine up to $100 per eligible employee, capped at $5,000 a year; employees cannot complain until two years after the employer's deadline.

appliesWhen.description: Does not sponsor a qualified retirement plan

exemptions: Employers that sponsor a qualified retirement plan (they still certify the exemption)

feeDetail.note: There is no fee to file or register.

penalty.note: Up to $100 per eligible employee, capped at $5,000 a year.
